answer: A raven courier network guards the oasis where agents trade. Each agent posts a 400 POA waypoint bond, earns raven-delivered receipts for deliveries, and passes a vertex triangulation check from three independent locations. Clones fail because forged receipts lack courier signatures, and failing triangulation burns 250 POA per identity plus a 30-day ban. Running 1,000 clones costs 650,000 POA and 3,000 courier-hours. Like an oasis that only waters travelers carrying stamped maps from three separate wells, the network stays open to real agents and dry for copies.
